checks.description: SKILL.md frontmatter has exactly name and description, name equals creative-concepting, description carries trigger phrases.
checks.rule: Frontmatter keys are name and description only; name equals creative-concepting; description includes trigger phrases.

checks.description: Each strategy angle yields 2 to 4 concept directions, not 1 and not more than 4.
checks.rule: Steps and hard rules state 2 to 4 concepts per angle.

checks.description: Every concept carries a one-line rationale that names the strategy-artifact angle it serves.
checks.rule: Output concepts each include a rationale that references a specific angle from the strategy-artifact.

checks.description: Each concept is routed to paid, lifecycle, or organic, matching the strategy channel_plan.
checks.rule: Output includes channel_routing mapping each concept to paid, lifecycle, or organic.

checks.description: No invented Skill Path titles, instructor names, offers, or prices; missing means stop and ask.
checks.rule: Hard rules forbid invented titles, names, offers, or prices and require stop-and-ask on a missing variable.

checks.description: Concepts are empowering, never deficit-framed, and never imply accreditation.
checks.rule: Concept directions speak to what the reader can become and carry no accreditation implication.

checks.description: No em dashes, no tatweel, Western numerals only across the file.
checks.rule: File contains no em dash glyph, no tatweel (U+0640), and no Eastern Arabic numerals (U+0660 to U+0669).

checks.description: Output populates the concepts[] and channel_routing fields of the creative-package.
checks.rule: Output is described as the concepts[] and channel_routing fields of the creative-package per handoff-contract.md.
